events.title: GAPI - 37th Annual Convention and Scientific Assembly
events.location: GAS South Convention Center, 6400 Sugarloaf Parkway, Duluth, Georgia 30097
events.description:
🌟 Invitation to the GAPI Annual Meeting 2026 🌟

Dear Friends and Colleagues,

We are delighted to invite you to the GAPI Annual Meeting, which will be held in Atlanta, Georgia, on the July 31st weekend.

This premier event brings together physicians, healthcare professionals, community leaders, and families from across Georgia and beyond for a memorable weekend of:

✅ Continuing Medical Education (CME) and professional development
✅ Networking with healthcare professionals and community leaders
✅ Engaging discussions on healthcare and public policy
✅ Bollywood entertainment and cultural programs
✅ Exceptional culinary experiences
✅ Opportunities to showcase your talent through singing, instrumental music, and other performances

We are also honored to welcome legislators, community leaders, and representatives from the Indian Consulate as part of this special gathering.

Whether you are a long-time member or attending for the first time, your presence will help make this event a meaningful celebration of professional excellence, cultural heritage, and community engagement.

📍 Location: GAS South Convention Center, 6400 Sugarloaf Parkway, Duluth, Georgia 30097 (View on Google Maps)
📅 Date: July 31st Weekend (July 31, 2026 - August 2, 2026)
🎤 Talent Showcase: Friday, July 31st, 2026
Great Gala meeting: Saturday August 1st, 2026.

We encourage all Georgia healthcare professionals, families, and friends to join us and be part of this exciting annual event.

Please share this invitation with anyone who may be interested.

We look forward to seeing you in Atlanta!

Warm Regards,
GAPI Annual Meeting Organizing Committee


Event Guidelines & Registration Details:
• This is an adults-only event in accordance with guidelines.
• Attire: Business formal.
• Exhibitor setup times: Friday, July 31, 4:30–9:00 PM, and Saturday, August 1, 7:30–8:30 AM.
• Registration: Registration is free for Medical students, Resident Physicians, and YPPI members. Please bring a screenshot of your confirmation email to expedite registration. Contact the organizers if you have any questions.

RSVP / Register Here

Visit gapi.org to become a member.

events.title: 2026 Greater Atlanta GAPI Regional Meeting & MSRF Health Fair
events.location: Jade Banquets - 4675 River Green Parkway, Duluth, GA 30096
events.description:
Greater Atlanta GAPI Regional Meeting & MSRF Health Fair – A Grand Success

The Georgia Association of Physicians of Indian Heritage (GAPI) successfully hosted the Greater Atlanta GAPI Regional Meeting on Saturday, January 17, 2026, at Jade Banquets, Duluth, Georgia. The event was conducted by Dr. Lalitha Medepalli, MD, FACC, Immediate Past President of GAPI (2025–26).

MSRF 2025–26 leadership team hosted GAPI MSRF-led Health Fair. The first ever MSRF Health Fair, held from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM, served over 60 community members and was organized by MSRF executive team: Anita Medepalli, Varun Nukala, Keerti Soundappan and Dr. Avi Singh. Attendees actively participated in hands-on CPR training for bystanders, preventive health screenings, diabetes screening, lifestyle counseling, and Ayurvedic and homeopathy consultations.
